title: My Bot is Printing even with terrible Price Action
author: StartExact9704
selftext:
Posted about my indicator, ATLAS a while back in one group and people said it wasfake. This is from NY session with the not so clean price action, and the confluence chain (bias → sweep → OB tap → MicroBOS) still tracked and fired correctly.

Not claiming it's perfect or that every signal wins, just sharing that the logic holds up under conditions that would usually shake out a lot of systems. Dashboard shows every step live so you can verify it's not cherry-picked after the fact. MOD, if this is not allowed, please remove it.
